pick.headline: United States invades Grenada
pick.summary: On 25 October 1983 US forces, with troops from several Caribbean states, invaded Grenada, a week after the island's prime minister was killed.
pick.significance: Operation Urgent Fury removed Grenada's military government and expelled its Cuban and Soviet advisers. It was the first US use of force to roll back a pro-Soviet government.
